plan.goal: Log in to Swag Labs, purchase the Sauce Labs Backpack, and complete checkout with the entered customer information.

steps.note: On the Swag Labs login page. Login is done once before the per-row loop, so this uses the literal username from the recording, not per-row data.

The password is masked, so the entered value is not visible in the recording; the login page states that the password for all listed users is secret_sauce. Login is done once before the per-row loop, so this uses the literal password from the recording, not per-row data.
Logs in and navigates to the Products page. Done once, before repeating the purchase per row.
Use the 'Add to cart' button for the Sauce Labs Backpack, priced at $29.99, not any other product's button.
The top-right cart icon; its accessible name changes with the item count, so it is named by its stable part 'Cart'.
On the cart page, advances to checkout.
First of the three fields on 'Checkout: Your Information'; its placeholder is not legible in the recording, but it precedes Last Name and Zip/Postal Code.
Second of the three fields on 'Checkout: Your Information'.
Advances to the checkout overview page showing payment, shipping, and price total.
On the checkout overview page, completes the order for this row; included in the repeating block so each row commits a purchase.

After 'Finish' the page is 'Checkout: Complete!' with no 'Add to cart' button, so return to the Products page via 'Back Home' at the end of each row iteration, making 'Add to cart' available again for the next row's purchase.

plan.expected_effect: The Products page (inventory.html) is displayed after the final Back Home step, showing Sauce Labs Backpack and other products with Add to cart buttons, the Sort products dropdown, and Cart, empty in the header, after each row's purchase was completed and the user returned home for the next row.
